window.sentence: 01 Jan 2021 – 31 Dec 2025: 179 harmonized hotspot-days, 1.6× the 2005–2024 median for the same dates (115); rank 2 of 21 years, far above normal.

current.sentence: December 1–31, 2025: no harmonized hotspots detected, as in most past years.
